g.text: WLD 105 DAY 3 — INSTRUCTOR KEY / PRINT-TO-PART GUIDE
Introduction to Welding Drawings: From Print to Part
PHYSICAL DEMONSTRATION
Hold Training Plate A or the matching cardboard/foam-board model in the FRONT VIEW orientation.
Ask: “Where is this edge on the print?” Rotate the part 90°. Ask: “What happened to the hole?”
Connect the changed view to hidden lines. Keep the line-type reference visible.
Repeat with the upper-right notch and the outside edges.
Teaching rule: Make the print physical. Keep asking where each paper feature lives on the part.
WHITEBOARD
PRINT → PART
WHAT is it? → title / identification
WHAT is it made from? → material
HOW BIG is it? → dimensions
WHERE are the features? → views / locations
WHAT can I see / what is hidden / where is center? → line types
READ → FIND → MEASURE → VERIFY → BUILD
WORKSHEET KEY
Title: TRAINING PLATE A • Material: Mild Steel • Thickness: 1/4 in
Visible line: any outside plate/notch edge • Hidden line: hole shown in top/right-side view
Centerline: center of the through-hole • Example dimension: 6 in overall length
Measure/verify targets: 6 in overall length • 4 in height • hole center 2 in from reference edges
Exit 1: Hidden line = feature exists but is not directly visible in that view.
Exit 2: Multiple views show features/dimensions one view cannot show clearly.
Exit 3: Read and verify the drawing requirements before layout/fabrication.

svg.text: “The print tells us what the part is supposed to be. The measuring tool tells us what the part actually is.”
Original PCCC/LTG instructor resource. Protected WLD 105 outcomes remain unchanged.
